rules: R6 overrides every conflicting historical value
Unfrozen parking/service facilities without permanent IDs are excluded
SVG coordinate mapping is frozen and may not auto-fit current geometry
One world meter equals one SVG user unit inside the map frame
World X maps right; world Z maps upward by inversion into SVG Y
Presentation profile may translate the map group but may not scale it
Step 4 layers 01 through 07 are immutable during Step 5; the Step 5 validator compares them against regenerated Step 4 output
Building footprints are centered on CampusData X/Z positions and use frozen rotationY; local +Z remains the main entrance direction
Undergraduate residence length remains the source range 78-82m; Step 5 renders a 78m minimum body plus 82m maximum control envelope instead of choosing a hidden 80m midpoint
Graduate residence control footprint is 72x18m and international residence control footprint is 72x20m
The 56 student residences remain 42 undergraduate + 10 graduate + 4 international and use an 8-template future model system
HSP-02 is rendered only as the 112x56m upper inpatient-tower overlay on HSP-01 with plan center (-1040,-1003); it is never rendered at the obsolete independent ground parcel
HSP-RSV-01 marks the former independent HSP-02 parcel only as reserve/open-space center because no final parcel footprint is frozen
Major track/plaza/stand records from the building table are routed to layer 10 and are not duplicated in the building layer
R6 outdoor sports control footprints are rendered exactly when present; TT-ENG-01, TT-HUM-01 and TT-MED-01 remain center markers because no control footprint is frozen
No raster image elements are permitted in generated masterplan SVG files

geometryCertainty.exactControlFootprints: Non-residence source rows with frozen length/width, graduate/international residences, R6 sports control footprints
geometryCertainty.rangeFootprints: 42 undergraduate residences: 78m minimum + 82m maximum envelope, width 18m
geometryCertainty.overlay: HSP-02 upper tower footprint; non-independent ground structure
